t: Teleport to Polis and see what is going on there.

You see, we're just scouts and researchers, not diplomats. We cannot make an alliance with an unknown sentient race without an approval from the high command.

I will send a request immediately. And you... you do whatever you want. Understood?
Ah, finally. As it was foretold, the Stormbringer will show up before the tempest.
Ask Cassandra about what is going on.

I'm sorry, that situation with demons threw me out of my stride... I completely lost the sense of time.

Welcome, stranger! I am Cassandra, the Domina of Fates. Take some rest and explore wonderful Polis, the first city of Aoidoi.

Thank you for your noble desire to help us. I will do whatever you wish to express my gratitude.

I hope we can talk later. I wish I could tell you more.

But time plays against us. We must hurry.
Help Kyros and Aellona drive demons away from Polis boundary.

Kyros, Aellona, and their legate followers went to protect Polis boundary. Your help would be invaluable.

You see, Kyros is the only warrior among them, and he's not almighty... or immortal. Aellona loves him more than anything and will follow him even into the flames of war. I'm afraid that her blind devotion might end tragically.

My heart is uneasy. Please go to the east as soon as you can!

Wakie-wakie! I congratulate you - you were murdered by a rather puny demon. That's a shame, huh?

What? What is it you babbling about paralyzation?
Solicit the support of a priest and fight the demon again.

Hm, this is curious... Since when demons have such powerful sorcerers? Well, this is not the most important thing right now. What is important, is that why that creature is still there, and we're here!

Alright, let's think. You see the ambassadors of the League and the Empire? Of course, there must be priests among them, who are eager to demonstrate the Holy power to the Aoidoi. Resurrection, Great Tensess, Nezeb, Skrakan, blah-blah-blah. Luckily for us, those priests are not just some charlatans. They hold real power. You should talk to one of them and make sure he supports you in battle with that demon.

What are you waiting for? Go!
That was a nice fight... Aellona! What happened to her?

A good fight is always a pleasure!

Don't think that I'm too old for that. These hands can still slaughter hundreds of evil creatures!
h: Ask to help in battle with the demon

t: I would love to help you, but I can't battle alongside my enemy.
h: Ask to help in battle with the demon

t:
I'm fine! Please, help Aellona!

I feel... I see... No, it can't be!

I'm fine! Please, help Aellona!

I feel... I see... No, it can't be!

I'm sorry.... I... don't know what I'm doing.

Aellona...

The last hope vanishes as soon as you touch the lifeless body.

Aellona is dead and gone.
Escort Kyros to Aellona's burial place.

There's a place just outside Polis where me and Aellona used to see each other...

She deserves to be buried there, among the beautiful rocks and trees. She asked me of that, not so long ago... As if she knew. Aellona always knew everything...

Will you help me? Wild animals will sense death and try to attack me while I carry her... body.

Here... here is the place. Here we met, seven years ago. Here I will lay her to rest...

I still remember that day as if it were yesterday. Astral storms and ice-cold winds had finally eased off... I was returning from a hunt, and then I saw Her, standing there and looking up. The light of a thousand shattered stars was gleaming on her face...

Her beauty will remain with Aoidoi forever - I will take care of that.
Gather wild flowers for Aellona's grave and bring them to Kyros.

Of all flowers, Aellona loved simple cornflowers best. They grow around here. I must lay them on her grave.

Please, be so kind to bring me several flowers. Maybe next year, I will find it all covered in blue cornflowers...
Those flowers grow all over the place. You won't miss them.

Thank you, my friend.

I can’t believe any of this... I was so foolish...  Now she’s gone. That was a cruel joke of the Well to give immortality to me, but deprive the other Aoidoi, while all of you can return to life just like that.

I... I need to be alone with Aellona, traveler.
Tell the dominae about Aellona's death.

The rest of the dominae must know what has happened. They must have already sensed... the death of one of us. Go and tell them everything.

I... I will be back. I just need some time.

I can see dire news in your eyes, Stormbringer. Aellona is dead - we all felt it.

...

I see... This is a dark day for us, stranger.  It's hard to describe how much we needed Aellona. The gift of knowledge and guidance is way too valuable for a newly born nation.

The Dominae must decide what we should do to protect our people. We have enemies now...
Find the boat neat the bank and reach the hunters' camp.

Listen, before I go to the Purgatory again: I am a Demon hunter. Our sorcerers from the White Fortress noticed a large pack of demons, heading to the depth of the Astral, and we decided to chase them. Agh... Damn it!

So we found them and destroyed them right next to this allod, but our ship was utterly wrecked. We decided to camp here and repair it. For a day, nothing happened, but then we were surrounded by other demons, like I've never seen in my life. They can play with your mind...

I was fixing the boat when I saw them. I killed a couple of them, but then one of the demons bewitched me with a vision. I came back to my senses on the other bank, all covered in blood. I don't even know where the boat is.

Listen, can you go and look what happened to our camp? Maybe they are alright? If they are, they better come here and rescue me!

"Who's that, Sivar, can you see?"

"They aren't demons! Put down the knife."

"If you say so, Sivar."
Talk to Epius in the Refuge and find out who Aoidoi are and where did they come from.

I'm sorry, I thought I sensed something hostile in you... But now I see your heart is friendly.

I am just a guard of the Refuge, and I don't know much. Please, come inside and meet Epius. He will answer your questions.
Demons can't reach us here, for the power of the Well of Soul protects the walls of the Refuge. But neither can we step outside them.

Each Aoidos carries the memory of demons, stranger. We knew that one day we will have to face them, but still their invasion caught us off guard.

The magic of the Well protects this refuge from their claws and fangs. Demons can't enter this place, but anyone who steps outside the barrier will most certainly fall victim to Chaos.
Find Aellona the Domina, who has gone looking for the Demonic Portal.

Here, in the Refuge, Aellona used to be in charge. She is a merciful and brave Domina. When Demons were at our doorstep, she gathered everyone who could bear arms and led them to battle. They drove the Demons away and followed them, but they never came back. I am her apprentice, and I can feel her rage and sadness. She has gone to the west, and you should search for her there, for no one else can show you the way to Polis.
A stranger? On Ammer? What are you doing here?
A stranger? I must admit I am surprised to meet you. Let me thank you, however. In this dark hour, I will gladly accept any help.
Talk to Aellona and ask her what she plans on doing next.
Do you want to ask something? Go ahead then.
I can see you have many questions, but there isn't much time to talk.

Dominae already know that the strangers have come to Ammer. I can speak on behalf of my people, and I say that we welcome you. The gates of Polis are open for everyone who favors creation over destruction. It is a shame though that the first ones who arrived here could only bring destruction...
Catch a bat and bring it to Aellona.

I can feel that you want to help me. I wouldn't dare to ask myself, but I would gladly accept any assistance.

These portals make so much noise, and I can't hear my beloved Kyros' heart. Is he safe? This is my only concern.

But who knows what is waiting on the other side of the portal? I have an idea... Could you please catch a bat? Take this magic decoy, it will help you.
Lure the bats with the decoy. They can be of help.
Now I will enchant it and send it on the other side of the portal. Hopefully, it will deliver my message and bring back the response.
Kill Demons in the Refuge vicinity and return to Aellona.

I wanted to ask you one more thing, though this request pains me. Chaos spawns are everywhere, and I fear for the Aoidoi who have found shelter within the walls of the Refuge. Our Sparks may return to the Flow after death, but death has different forms, and ours is such that when we die, we lose ourselves. I don't want this fate for the Aoidoi, which is why I am asking you to cut down those spawns of chaos without mercy. Let them quake in terror!
Thank you. I hope you will enjoy this reward.

Telepathy is a gift that I share with other Dominae and with some of my students. No, we can’t read thoughts - just images and emotions, but even that is enough to put two and two together. Cassandra and Epius informed me that you’re on your way.

I’m glad it took you less time to get here than I expected.
h: Did you know I was coming?

t:
Bloodshed. Death. War. You were born on a dark day, Stormbringer, just as predicted.

Kyros, my beloved one, is a strong warrior. He forbade me from following him, but now this troubles me, for I can feel he is wounded, and there is no one to help him.
My name is Aellona. I am a Domina - it is my title and my great responsibility. Why were you looking for me?

Well... Dominae bear a piece of the Creators' memory. We possess our knowledge right from the minute of our birth, and we also feel each other, wherever we are. So, we knew that you were coming. That's why we're just surprised, not shocked.
h: Ask how Aellona knows about the expedition

t: Kyros, my beloved one, is a strong warrior. He forbade me from following him, but now this troubles me, for I can feel he is wounded, and there is no one to help him.
h: Ask what Aellona is waiting for here

t: Enter the Demonic Portal and find Kyros on the other say.

The bat is back! My plan has worked. I can feel Kyros' anger... There are so many enemies around him. He tells me to bring help, but who is going to help us?! We can't wait for the reinforcement from Polis! I must help him now! Will you come with me?
Who? What?! How did you get here?!
What?! I asked Aellona to stay out of this... Oh, women!
Protect Kyros while he is destroying the Demonic claws.

Are you wondering why I’m not asking you who you are and where you're from? Me and Aellona can feel each other better than any other Dominae, and I know that you're a friend of hers who has come from a distant land to help, and the rest doesn't matter.

The only thing that matters is expelling that demonic filth. Otherwise it will devour everything and become so powerful that even the walls of Polis, blessed with the breath of the creators, won't withstand it.

Will you help? I don't have the strength to destroy the enemy and chase away the filth at the same time. Your sword will be my only protection!
Go ahead! We don't have much time.
I'm glad to see how fiercely you fight our common enemies. The sons of Chaos have brought death to our lands, but you are giving us hope!
Destroy Desolator and return to the Refuge.

It is too soon to celebrate - I can sense the presence of the one who has brought that army to our lands. Anger and madness overwhelm him... I can't believe the Creator could let such ugly monsters invade his beautiful world. We must stop the hateful enemy!
Well, I'm glad that our paths crossed. I can see you have many questions. I'm afraid I can't answer them all.
We won! It’s time to return to the Refuge.

Other Aoidoi do not approve of my passion for battles... But this is not my fault that the Creators chose to endow me with the gift of swordsmanship!

I can see you want to ask many questions. We should go back now and have a conversation over a glass of beer in the Refuge.
Find traces of intruders next to the Site of Power in Celestial Fingers.

Since you’re still here, there’s another issue that might need your... unique talent for dealing with them. Our scouts report that League soldiers were spotted around the Site of Power located in the center of this island.

I don’t like dealing with unknown variables. I’d like to know what mysterious guests we are having here.

Cough... Cough...

Who are you? Although, who cares... Cough... I’m gonna die anyway!
Find traces of intruders next to the Site of Power in Celestial Fingers.

Still here? Good, good, I have a job for you. Our eagles report that there’s something suspicious going on around a Site of Power. The one that’s right in the center of the island, yeah. There are some scouts, and though they don’t look like they are from the Empire, it’s still nothing good.

We should find out who they are and what they need. We have enough problems as it is...

Cough... Cough...

Who are you? Although, who cares... Cough... I’m gonna die anyway!
Find three escaped fighters and bring them back to Rabid family.

"Where are our fighters, Sivar? Are they chilling in the camp?"

"They ran with you when the demon appeared. It's just you ran toward it, and they were running away from it."

"But I caught it, Sivar!"

"Good job, Rudy, but why would you tear at it with your teeth?"

"I don't know, Sivar, it seemed to me that... Hey, you! Where are the rest of the fighters? Why aren't you on duty?!"

"Rudy, you said it wasn't neither a fighter nor a demon. Maybe I can eat it after all?"

"Calm down, Sivar. Maybe it will find the rest of the guys. Then you can eat it."

"Rudy, I will eat him!"

"Calm down, Sivar, you haven't finished the demon yet."

"Rudy, are those our fighters?"

"Looks like that, Sivar. Fighters, why does the sun shine?!"

"Look at them, they can't say a word. They must be our fighters after all."
Find the lost weapon and bring it to the Rabid family.

"Rudy, where is my chipper?"

"Sivar, what do you need the axe for?"

"Erm, I don't remember. I need my chipper! You hear me?! I need it!!"

"Calm down, Sivar, you will find your axe. And your sword. And your knives. Right?"

"I told you you would find it."

"Find what, Rudy?"

"Your weapon!"

"What weapon?"

"Agh, shut up, Sivar!"
Destroy demons near the Hunters' camp and talk to the survivors.

"One, two, three, four, five... Is five a lot or not, Rudy?"

"That's enough, Sivar."

"Enough for what?"

"For... well..."

"Let's kill them all, Rudy!"

"No, they have to kill the demons! That's why they came back, right?"
Pretend that you don't know me, alright?
You're right on time! I didn't know what to do next: the demons can't break my charms, and I can't kill them because of my charms.
Speak to Eladia, find out what is going on on Ammer and what is happening in the north part of Kardis Isthmus.
Don't look at me like that. Just pretend you don't know me, okay? Give me a minute, and I will tell you everything.
Who are you? What is your intention?
Stop! You're not one of us, are you? Anyway, since you're here, you can help!

You must be wondering what I am doing here. Well, just like every one else involved, I am very interested in the legacy of the fallen gods. Coming here in my true incarnation would prompt unnecessary questions, so I'm kind of acting incognito.

I supposed that after Sarn's death demons would break loose, and I was right. So when I noticed a large pack of demons heading toward this place, I joined the demon hunters who were chasing them.

This is it, basically. I would tell you more, but I'm afraid I don't have the time.

What am I planning to do? Well, have a cup of coffee, take a bath, listen to Etienne de Blizar's opera... But first I need to survive, because there are much more demons here than I expected. We barely survived the first attack. This place must be feeding them with some kind of power. I can only learn more about that if you helped me sustain that defensive barrier.

I can feel the echo of powerful magic coming from the north. I don't know who's fighting demons down there, but right now I could use help from anyone.
h: Ask what Eladia plans to do

t: Obtain demon hearts on Kardis Isthmus and return to Eladia.

Oh, I almost forgot. The demons that attacked us are very different from their regular Astral kinsmen. They are way too strong and smart.

If you happen to kill a demon, please bring me its heart. I am wasting too much energy sustaining this barrier. If they attack again, I could use any extra source of power.
If you happen to kill a demon, please bring me its heart. I am wasting too much energy sustaining this barrier. If they attack again, I could use any extra source of power.
Obtain demon hearts on Cadis Isthmus and return to Eladia.
Since you're here, can you help me? You see, I am in desperate need of demon hearts. What for? To eat them, of course! I'm running out of energy.
I'm still waiting for those hearts.

Well, I guess I'm going to have to make use of it.

What? No, I'm not going to eat it! Just conduct a small energy-transmuting ritual...

You go bring me some more hearts!
The Throne Room of the Dead City changed quite a bit over the summer...
Together with Franz de Vevre return to the battle site in the north of Kardis Isthmus.

You... I know you! I saw you in the White Fortress, when it was attacked by demons. And here you are again, coming for help. Is this a coincidence?

Alas, it's too late. My friends must be dead already. Demons attacked us outside the camp, and we were fighting desperately, but there were just too many of them. And I... I don't know what happened to me - my mind was fogged. I ran away without realizing what I was doing.

We should go back and see the battle site, but I'm too scared. I fear that the demons can possess my mind again. Will you help me?
What? I'm sorry, I got distracted.
Who is that?! I remember when I thought that demon was going to kill me, some stranger came to the rescue... Was that him?!
Together with Franz de Vevre go to the north of Kardis Isthmus and find out where the dead stranger had come from.

We should head to the north - the stranger's footprints come from there.

Reckless braveheart... What if he didn't believe in the Light and didn't resurrect? That would be a shame. We should find out who he was.

We must have found the kinsmen of the deceased. I can't understand a word they are saying!

Listen, I have an idea...
Grab the stranger by the hand and defeat him in the battle of minds.

I can connect your minds! You will be able to speak without words. Although I'm not sure he will like it...

All you have to do is to touch him. Or grab his hand.
What are you doing?! I feel... weird!
The stranger does not extend his hand in return. Looks like force is necessary...
Find Goblin Carriers, escort them to the Imperial outpost and speak with Yaver Nut.

Listen to your assignment, soldier!

On the west from here, there's a small camp that guards the approach route to the outpost. I believe they must be running out of supplies. I was going to send you there to keep the watch anyway, so now I'm also asking you to look for our goblin carriers. They got lost somewhere on their way.

And then someone's got to keep an eye on them, or they will just either eat the supplies themselves or get eaten by wild animals.

Oh, hi there. I'm sorry, I'm a bit busy - I'm thinking. Wait just another three... two... one... Alright, I'm done. Here's what I think: you are the warrior that whole Nezebgrad has been talking about. That's good; I might need your help.
Alright, alright. Just don't kick me!
Track down the strange animal and return to Khoor-Kaas.

My soldiers saw a strange animal in the outpost vicinity. Well, they did not exactly see it - they just noticed something moving in the bushes, but when they got there, it was gone.

The strange thing is, the beast keeps on coming back every time we scare it away. I think it's just waiting for the right time to attack and eat us.

My watchmen are too clumsy and can't sneak up on it unnoticed. Maybe you try?

If you find anything, talk to our pathfinder. I would have sent him to track down the beast already, but that idiot got poisoned with some local fruits and has to stay around the loo...
Eysh, comrade! What do you want?
Eysh, kylys! Did you find the trail of the beast? Let me see...
Collect leaves and branches and bring them to Khoor-Kaas.

I know who this fur belongs to!

I've seen them a couple of times. Those little creatures are called gibberlings. I swear this is their fur. They are League spies, zoor? It means, the League is here and they're watching us... Shoysh!

Without their spies, those Kanians will know nothing about us. So we just have to take them down for now. If you want to sneak up on them, you're going to need a good disguise. Bring me some leaves and branches, and I will make it for you, eysh!
Find some fine leaves and branches. I could do it myself, but I'm not feeling very good...
Here you go. I swear they won't tell you from a tussock!
Use the disguise to sneak up to the League spies and return to Yaver Nut.
So, ready to go! Put on the cloak and crawl up to the spies. The sergeant's going to be so happy when you get rid of them!
Did you find out who's lurking in the bushes?

So, the League is here too? That’s news. But I’m not surprised – we're always no more than half a step ahead of them. And I intend to increase that distance by a step at least, otherwise we’ll be bound hand and foot here.
Place traps along the road from the Imperial Outpost to the center of the Allod, then report to Yaver Nut.

I know one good cure for curiosity... Actually, it's for bears, but it will work on gibberlings, too.

Here, take it. Place it in a bush, and pretty soon we will hear three piteous shouts, huh.
Just set the traps. It will be enough.
Have you set all the traps? Alright, let's just wait now.
Find the League camp and launch the signal rocket, then return to Yaver Nut.

Since the League spies on us, we should do the same and pay them a courtesy visit.

Since there are no League ships hanging above us, it means they have a camp somewhere nearby.

If you find it, launch a signal rocket. We will send our "friendship team" right away, huh.
Have you found the League camp?
Alright, we've got the signal! Our soldiers are ready, and now no stupid high command with their armistice will get in our way.
Catch 15 crabs and boil then in a geyser. Then take the boiled crabs to Khoor-Kaas.

There are lots of crabs near the lake to the east of the camp. Want to try the local fauna? Catch a few crabs, then boil them right there in a geyser. And I’ll see if we have anything to drink around here...
Crabs! There they are. Come on, quick, the drinks are getting warm.
Find the supply convoy, escort it to the League camp and meet Usina Sapogov.

Here is the deal. You're no good for the watch - you're way too heroic and capricious for that. We should put your energy to some proper use.

We've explored this area, but we still have no idea what's beyond the east outspot. I've sent a supply convoy to the watch, but they must have got lost on the way. Can you find them and escort to the outpost? And don't forget to look around!

If you notice anything, report immediately!

Oh, the food is here! And you must be the new scout?

Yes, I can see it clearly. You were meant for fieldwork, haha!
Search the surroundings of the League camp and find the trails of the mysterious spies.

Someone's spying on us, and no matter how hard we try, we can't catch them. We don't even know whether it's a beast or a human being.

Here's what I think: if somebody's been watching us, perharps they already know everything about us. But they're not expecting you. Why don't you look around - maybe you'll notice something?
Imperial spies?! Oh my! How could we let them get so close!
Give the empty bottle to Marius de Ardeur.

There can be no mistake: they are from the Empire. However, I'm not sure what that potion in the bottle was... What if they wanted to poison the spring?

Listen, bring this bottle to Marius, our sorcerer and alchemist. The elf knows his onions. Maybe he'll recognize the smell.

A bottle dropped by the Imperial spies? Hm, let me take a look at it.

Phew, what a stink! Don't they brush their teeth at all?
Gather Wolf Eye berries near the camp and bring them to Marius de Ardeur.

Looks like that was a distracting potion. No wonder our sentries didn't notice a thing: this magic potion is extremely difficult to spot. Now when you know who's our enemy, you can surprise them.

I know that Wolf Eye berry grows in this area. Bring me some, and I will make a decoction that will come in very handy for us. Just don't eat it! That would be a very shameful death.
I need Wolf Eye. It's the crucial ingredient.
Nice berries! Now give me a minute...
Drink the Decoction of True Vision, kill the Imperial spies, and report to Usina Sapogov.

Alright, here you go. Just one sip - and you will see even through the thickest haze. After two sips you will see things that nobody is really supposed to see. Well, after three sips people usually see the Purgatory, so don't get carried away. When you're done with the spies, let our gloomy lieutenant know the good news.
What do you have for me?
You've killed the Imperial spies? That's something I love to hear! I can't wait until this stupid ceasefire is over.
Set the signal rockets around the camp and report to Usina Sapogov.

I have an idea. Since we know that enemy spies are lurking in the bushes, why don't we set a trap for them?

I have a couple of signal rockets. We could string a rope between two trees and attach those rockets to it - the spies will never notice it in the dark. And we will definitely notice the fireworks!

Will you help me do that?
Find the Empire camp and launch the signal rocket, then return to Yaver Nut.

How about we all play this game together?

If the Empire has its soldiers spying on us, and there are no Imperial ships hanging above us, it means they have a camp somewhere nearby.

I know you don't like to sit around and wait, so why don't you go search the woods and give us a signal if you find their camp?
Have you found the Empire camp?
Alright, we've got the signal! Our soldiers are ready, and now no stupid high command with their armistice will get in our way.
Catch 15 crabs and boil then in a geyser. Then take the boiled crabs to Usina.

There are lots of crabs near the lake to the east of the camp. Want to try the local fauna? Catch a few crabs, then boil them right there in a geyser. And I’ll see if we have anything to drink around here...
Crabs! There they are. Come on, quick, the drinks are getting warm.
Survive the dangers of the Secret Paths and stop Kyros.

Well, well, the boy is ambitious. How fast they grow!

Alright. The thing is, Kyros has all chances to achieve his goal. How do I know that? Well, let’s call it intuition. I can feel a mysterious power in him.

To follow Kyros if he opens the portal, you will have to enter the Well of Souls. Yes, that pillar of light which spawns newborn Aoidoi. My magic will direct you right to the Secret Paths, the deepest layer of the Planar Rim. I don't know what is waiting for you down there. If you are lucky, you will find an entrance to the Purgatory. And you will be the first mortal in history to enter it alive.

But you're used to it, aren't you?
Good luck. This time you will need it.

This is going nowhere good.

Well, for now we're fine - we've defeated Kyros, the Servant of Tensess is on his duty again.

But the most important question is - where did Kyros get such power? His body was reshaped by the Primal Chaos itself. Do you understand what that means? I think my father has something to do with that. He must be somewhere near.

I can sense him.

I don't know what he has in mind, but be careful. I will do my best to keep him out of Sarnaut, but you already know that I can't do that on my own.
Kill Sabertooth Squirrels and their leader near the Imperial camp and collect the reward from Hatchet the Montane.

Hey, you watch out there. The squirrels are crazy in these woods! I've seen nothing like that even on the Wild Isles. They've got teeth as big as human fingers! I tell you, they can bite through steel.

See these four holes on my hip? That's them! If you kill a couple of the furry wretches, I will owe you one!
So, no more squirrels in these woods? Good job! Thank you, friend. Here's your reward.
Kill Sabertooth Squirrels near the Imperial camp and collect the reward from Hatchet the Montane.

Hey, you watch out there. The squirrels are crazy in these woods! I've seen nothing like that even on the Wild Isles. They've got teeth as big as human fingers! I tell you, they can bite through steel.
So, no more squirrels in these woods? Good job! Thank you, friend. Here's your reward.
Find Bowstring the Bosque in the grove near the Imperial camp.

Hey comrade! Have you seen an orcish lady around here? A tall one, with a bow?

She promised to stop by yesterday, and there's still no sign of her. I know her; if she promises something, she keeps her word!

Listen, you are allowed to leave the camp, aren't you? Can you please look for my friend? She said she'd go hunting...

Phew! I thought I'd die here! And hardly anything can be worse than being eaten by these monsters.

I must say, I've never been rescued before. I feel a little embarrassed.
Kill the spider queen and her servants and return to Bowstring the Bosque.

I got into such a mess! I was just walking through the forest when I saw a cobweb and decided to swat it. So, I swatted the stupid thing... I got stuck immediately, the web was strong as steel. While I was trying to break free, those eight-legged monsters surrounded me and wrapped me in a cocoon before I could say a thing! And the huge mother spider kept staring at me and prodding me... Yu-u-u-uck, I almost threw up.

Hey, would you do me a favor? Cut those monsters’ and their queen’s legs right off! I would do it myself, but I'm still nauseous from the poison.
Give hell to the damned spiders!
Thank the Light, she’s alive! Thank you. I’m really glad to hear it.
Kill 10 bats near the League camp and return to Chivisa Artful.

Do you see them? Do you? Neither do I. Cursed creatures! I can sense their presense, but I can't see where they hide.

Who? Ah, you must be new here.

Every night it's a nightmare. Every night we are attacked by a whole flock of huge bloodsucking bats!

Listen, you're not going to sit around in the camp, are you? Can you do us a favor and kill the damned things? We will find a way to thank you!
Hey, did you find a way to get rid of the bats?
No more damned bats? Ah, this is good news! Now we can keep our watch safely.
Kill 10 bats near the League camp and return to Chivisa Artful.

Do you see them? Do you? Neither do I. Cursed creatures! I can sense their presence, but I can't see where they hide.

Who? Ah, you must be new here.

Every night it's a nightmare. Every night we are attacked by a whole flock of huge bloodsucking bats!

Listen, you're not going to sit around in the camp, are you? Can you do us a favor and kill the damned things? We will find a way to thank you!
Hey, did you find a way to get rid of the bats?
No more damned bats? Ah, this is good news! Now we can keep our watch safely.
Tell Bronislav Malinovsky about the sentry's body.

This body has been terribly disfigured. It was torn apart with claws and fangs, and the wounds on the chest look as if it was pierced with a spear. But animals don't use spears!

Bronislav Malinovsky and other sentries should be warned of the incident.
What? Somebody killed a sentry and nobody noticed?
Right into the city of the stone monsters? Oh my...
Find the Manticore near the League camp and bring its head to Bronislav Malinovsky.

If you see that beast that killed my sentry, you should chop it into little pieces! But don't forget to bring its head to me - I will use it as a deterrence against other monsters who think they can just come and slaughter my soldiers.
So that was a Manticore? What a monstrous thing! Thank you so much for helping us!
Obtain rock samples and return to Negus Setuteph at the Imperial outpost.

As far as I'm concerned, you're not a big fan of theoretic research and prefer fieldwork, if I may say so? This is just excellent!

You see, dear colleague, this allods tends to disprove all theories of evolution and evolvement. Even local minerals make my brain squeak like a rusty barrow! Normally, an allod's structure resembles a layer-cake: the more solid a material is, the deeper it lies. And here it's an absolute paradoxical mess!

Could you please be so kind and bring me some samples for the study? Anything will do, from mica to limestone. Maybe this will clear things up...
Any minerals will do - mica, granite, whatever! Even limestone.
Mica, granite, pumice, limestone... all mixed into a weirdest blend. What on earth is that? We need to find out more.
Catch a bird, a frog, a jerboa, and a spider, and bring them to Negus Setuteph.

I suggest we stop researching the nonliving world and turn to the living one.

I have noticed that the local fauna is very peculiar. Its representatives seem to be identical with the common species that we are used to, but this similarity ends with their physical appearances. Imagine that: a gopher bit through my steel prosthesis when I was trying to dissect it! I had to exterminate the specimen, and I would be very thankful if you could help me obtain some more experiment samples.
Did you catch anything, dear colleague?

Let me see...

My analyzers show that their vital energy is two or three times higher than normally! This is absolutely unbelievable!

At first I thought I had made a mistake when I was researching the flora samples, but now I see that each one of these is just so full of life! However, I have no idea what causes this deviation.
Bring samples of the local flora to Negus Setuteph.

I think we should go back to studying flora. Something tells me that the results of this research will be even more surprising.

Have you already noticed that fern here grows right next to redbud? It is absolutely impossible under usual conditions, but this is not our case. Could you please bring me some flora samples so that I could make a deeper study?
A precise analysis requires different species.

So, we have a prehistoric fern, a tree, and a flower. They are all full of vital energy, and what's more interesting, they are all of approximately the same age! This is just nonsense. Under usual cinditions, they would be divided according to their habitat. What does it say to us?
Take the chronometer readings in the spots marked by Negus Setuteph and return to him.

So, what do we have? Plants and animals hold tremendous vital power, and the species are mixed up in the way they could never be under usual conditions. The same relates to minerals which are not divided into layers as they should be.

What conclusion can we make? I have only one hypothesis, and your three-day delay fits in it perfectly - here, time doesn't go in the same way it does in the rest of Sarnaut. This hypothesis needs a proof, this is why I ask you, my dear colleague, to set these chronometers in three equidistant spots outside the camp. Their readings will show us whether I am right or not.

They will confirm my hypothesis!

This is it! All three chronographs show different time! And the closer they are to the center of the allod, the bigger is the differnce. I'm sure, time used to run much faster in this place!

Do you understand what this means? What took days in Sarnaut, took years on the periphery of this allod, and decades in its center. Happily for us, the difference is not that big anymore and it keeps declining. This is just incredible! We must reach the center of the allod. I'm sure there we will find the cause of that phenomena.
Have you got any good news?
Obtain rock samples and return to Ursula de Blizare at the League camp.

Greetings. I heard your conversation with Bronislav and, honestly, I don't understand a thing.

You see, this allods tends to disprove all theories of evolution and evolvement. Even plain rocks are wrong! Normally, an allod's structure resembles a layer-cake: the more solid a material is, the deeper it lies. And here it's an absolute paradoxical mess!

Could you please be so kind and bring me some samples for the study? Anything will do, from mica to limestone. Maybe this will clear things up...
Bring me anything you can find - limestone, mica, whatever! Right now, I have no idea how this allod can exist at all.
Mica, granite, pumice, limestone... all mixed into a weirdest blend. What on earth is that? We need to find out more.
Catch a bird, a frog, a jerboa, and a spider and bring them to Gaal-Tohtar.

I could use some help, before this place drives me completely insane!

Local animals do look like usual ones, but their habits are very different. I can find a way to connect with almost any animal, but here they just don't hear me and run away if I try to approach them.

Maybe you have more luck? Can you please catch some birds or lizards or a grasshopper? I just want to take a closer look at them, eysh!

Nice catch, eysh! Let me see...

Shoysh! It can't be!

This little gopher has more vital power than a tiger! It is just full of life, like everything around us, eysh!

This is some kind of magic, I swear on the spirits of ancestors. Every little tree on this blessed land is filled with power!
Bring cuts of olive, redbud, and laurel to Ursula de Blizare.

The age of this allod can be calculated not only from its minerals, but also from its flora. Something tells me that the results of this research will be even more surprising.

However, let's not jump into conclusions. First, we need to study some tree cuts. If they indeed had been created with magic, as my furry friend supposes, than they will look rather differently from those grown naturally.
Here's your saw, there are the trees - come on, we have much work to do!

Very interesting... The trees look old, but they all have from one to three year rings, and the rings that are closer to the center are much thicker than the outer ones. I have a conjecture about how it all could happen, and I need you to help me prove it!
Take the chronometer readings in the spots marked by Ursula de Blizare and return to her.

So now it is a confirmed fact: time runs differently in this place. But how exactly does it happen? That's a good question. The first one we should answer, actually.

Take these three chronographs and place them in three different spots. If I am right, then they will most likely show different time after a while. I can’t wait to see the results!
Set the chronographs on the north, south, and west from the camp, and I will try and put their readings together into some kind of a consistent theory.

This is it! All three chronographs show different time! And the closer they are to the center of the allod, the bigger is the differnce. I'm sure, time used to run much faster in this place!

Do you understand what this means? What took days in Sarnaut, took years on the periphery of this allod, and decades in its center. Happily for us, the difference is not that big anymore and it keeps declining. This is just incredible! We must reach the center of the allod. I'm sure there we will find the cause of that phenomena.
Find the sentries who went to the Imperial camp.

Hey! I've got a request for you. We're friends, aren't we?

I can't find our sentries anywhere. There's a guarding camp to the west from here, and the guards change at the same time every day.

The previous shift was supposed to return already, but they still haven't. Can you please go and see what's the matter with them?
Try to wake up the soldier and find out what happened.

The soldier sleeps on duty! This a military court case!

But there is something suspicious about his sleepy mumbling... How could four seasoned soldiers just fall asleep all at the same time? They need to be questioned.
Destroy tobacco bushes infected with the mushroom spores and return to Puff the Mariner.

We fell asleep on duty... Oh, we can be sentenced for that!

Listen, it wasn't our fault! How could we know there was something wrong with the local plants?

So this is what happened: a had a tobacco seed in my pocket. I had noticed that everything here grows like crazy; so I planted that seed, and the next day, there was a bush of fine tobacco! I cut it down, dried it, and then when the guys came to take their shift, I offered them to share a pipe... We all pulled at it just once, and then we fell where we stood!

I can't even move my arms, and my head feels awfully hazy... Destroy that tobacco, will you? Nobody should ever smoke that again...

So you say it was all because of mushrooms? They infected our tobacco?

Alright, I have another tobacco seed. But this time I will plant it in a pot!
Meet Aristarchus Palubin at the Nezebgrad port.

Finally. I'm not going to beat around the bush - we are starting a research expedition, and I want you in it. I think you know why. Our scouts report that the Astral storm on the site of the greatest battle in the history of Sarnaut has finally eased off. We know the League is sending their ships there, too.

I don't know what they will find there. Maybe nothing, and maybe a legacy of the gods that can decide the outcome of our war. And I'm not going to take risks.

The ships are ready to depart, so hurry up. Remember - the Empire counts on you!
Good day, officer! Our crew is ready for departure, but there is one thing...
Talk to Alexandra Soldina about guarding "Workers' Pride"

Frankly, there was no need to hurry - we're not flying anywhere right now. The Astral is swarming with enraged Demons. You can't avoid facing them when you're out there. We can hold on as long as our cannons keep them at distance, but if they make it to the deck, we're done for.

As far as I know, you're on a friendly footing with mercenaries? Why don't you ask them to join us? The Empire will pay generously!

Do you want to hire mercenaries? That we can provide, but here's the thing...

We are used to fighting demons, but only on allods and not in the open Astral on the other side of the world. That requires special qualifications.
Settle the cooperation conditions with the mercenaries.

I know I can trust you, but I can't make my guys do what they don't want to. And, honestly, I'm not really eager to risk their lives right now. You will have to speak with them personally. Maybe some will join you.

Hey! Stay where you are!

Are you standing still? Just let me take aim...
Tell Aristarchus Palubin that the mercenaries are ready.

Huh, thank you. The cannon works. It didn't blast you to bits, so we can consider the experiment a success, he he.

So, whom did you say we need to shoot? A couple of demons? No problem at all, happy to do it – maybe another interesting idea will come up...
Is everyone present? Great. Come on, jump on board.
Board the ship and follow the expedition flagship.
Don't worry! We have the best engines in the whole Empire fleet. We'll catch up with them in no time!
I can't believe my eyes... Where have you been for three days?!
Meet Igor Compasov in the port of Novograd.

Good day, good day... I have an urgent request for you.

Our intelligence report that the Astral storm on the site of the greatest battle in the history of Sarnaut - you know what I'm talking about - has finally eased off. We know the Empire is sending their research ships there, and so should we.

I don't know what they will find there. Maybe nothing, and maybe a legacy of the gods that can decide the outcome of our war. And I'm not going to take risks.

The ships are ready to depart, so hurry up. Remember - the League counts on you!
Oh hello. So it's who you I've been waiting for?
Talk to Vlastemir Naimitov about guarding "Firefly".

Frankly, there was no need to hurry - we're not flying anywhere right now. The Astral is swarming with enraged Demons. You can't avoid facing them when you're out there. We can hold on as long as our cannons keep them at distance, but if they make it to the deck, we're done for.

As far as I know, you're on a friendly footing with mercenaries? Why don't you ask them to join us? We will pay generously!

Do you want to hire mercenaries? That we can provide, but here's the thing...

We are used to fighting demons, but only on allods and not in the open Astral on the other side of the world. That requires special qualifications.
Settle the cooperation conditions with the mercenaries.

I know I can trust you, but I can't make my guys do what they don't want to. And, honestly, I'm not really eager to risk their lives right now. You will have to speak with them personally. Maybe some will join you.

Hey! Stay where you are!

Are you standing still? Just let me take aim...
Fight with Demons? Sure, I'd love that! I'll bring a couple of my buddies along.
h: Ask if Casper wants to guard the expedition

t: Obtain 20 terminal clamps from broken Mechanoids and Clanking Destroyers on Irdrich and bring them to the Kaboom family.

Come on, who sent you? Was it Shesterkin? We already told him we're not revealing the secret of our grenade mix!

Not him? Huh! So you probably want to hire us. Alright, but there's one business that we've got to finish, and you can help us. We need twenty terminal clamps.

You see those rusty metal chunks over there? There's plenty of those in them. The walking ones have even more!
Hey, get out of the way!
Sooo... I guess this goes here, and that goes there... It works!
Destroy two Castle Mechanoids after breaking their shields with the gibberlings' device and return to the Kaboom family.

It works! This is a true engineering discovery!

And you have a unique opportunity to test it! Don't worry, the devices that we invent almost always work.

We saw a couple of bulky metal dolts around here with some kind of energy cocoons around them. We bet our gun will break their shields with one shot.

You help us, and we will help you. Deal?
Look here, and aim there. Don't mix it up!

Great, everything works!

Scaggy, you lost - all hands are still attached. It's a shame you didn't trust your own family!
Tell Igor Compasov that the mercenaries are ready.

Huh, thank you. The cannon works. It didn't blast you to bits, so we can consider the experiment a success, he he.

So, whom did you say we need to shoot? A couple of demons? No problem at all, happy to do it – maybe another interesting idea will come up...
Is everyone present? Great. Come on, jump on board.
Board the ship and follow the expedition flagship.
Don't worry! We have the best engines in the whole League fleet. We'll catch up with them in no time!
This is unbelievable. Where the hell have you been for three days?

On behalf of all Aoidoi, I thank you for helping Kyros. If it were not for you, who knows where his arrogance would get us? A death of each one of us is a great loss.

We decided that you should attend our Forum. I must ask you not to speak unless you are being addressed. This is our duty as the dominae - we have to settle any strife all by ourselves, and not let anything slip outside.

Let's not waste time. We should deal with this as soon as possible.
What do you want to know?

Madman! Grief has clouded his mind...

But where does that great power come from? Why couldn't we defeat him?
Come to Polis and ask Eladia for help.

We can still... feel Kyros. Touching his mind is like fire walking. I'm afraid that in his madness he might kill any of us if we try to pursue him. But we cannot let him into the outer world!

I am most worried about the strange nature of the portal that he opened up. This is not Aoidoi magic, Stormbringer, this is something completely different! We have never seen it before. The mere sight of the portal instills terror in our hearts!

We have to ask you to help us once again. Your people have been in this world much longer than we have. Maybe some of the mages that you know can tell us what it is?

I was just wondering where the hell you were.

Hurry, we don't have much time.
Use Eladia's device to measure magical disturbances on the Forum, near the Well of Souls, and in Polis center.

This damned allod is falling apart at the seams. On the spatial, magical level, of course. Portal magic does no good to a newly born land. It could barely sustain the demonic portals, but Kyros has created something completely different...

The allod is screaming in terror. Do you understand that? You should thank your gods you can't hear it.

We need to find where Kyros went before he does something worse. We will use the old reliable technique of triangulation. We need to measure magical disturbances in three key points around Polis. Then, using that data, we will find the rupture in space... As simple as that.

Meanwhile, I will stabilize the subspace, or our newly born race will soon have to sail across the open Astral.
Are you done? Great. Let's see.
Go to the place where the portal was opened and find out where Kyros went.

Here it is! I knew he couldn't get too far away in the material world. Look - the portal is located right here.

Now you should go there and find out where Kyros went. If you find him, I suggest you don't fight him. Who knows what he's got up his sleeve? And then, I would like to interrogate him myself and find out who taught him this magic. And how come that dominae telepathy does not allow us to do it right now.
Great mysteries can solve themselves, you know.

Hm, let me see. A spear... I can't say much about it; you better show it to the locals. Crystals... hm.

Damn it. This can be only one sort of magic.

It looks like this was a herd of horses. But not wild ones - the prints of horseshoes can be seen clearly.

And Aoidoi do not breed horses...
Ask Eladia about the nature of the portal and ask the dominae for help.

The magic in these crystals is very similar to the kind Nihaz used. Basically, these crystals are extremely powerful mana batteries. One of them can hold enough energy to destroy this whole allod. And there were... how many of them? And they are all empty. All their energy was used to open a portal. But where did it lead? Oh, of course...
Do you want to tell me something?
Indeed, providence must be guiding you, Stormbringer. I was going to send for you myself. Something mysterious has happened.
Go to Celestia and ask about the wounded orc.

An hour ago our scouts found a wounded orc near the city wall. They say, he is in a really bad condition. He's delirious and mumbles something all the time. They took him to Celestia, our best healer.

Maybe this is the lead that you're looking for. Go to Celestia and find out what had happened to him.
I'm sorry I couldn't save him...
Church? Well, this makes it easier, right? The representatives of the Trinity Church most probably know him.

I'm very sorry, but I couldn't save that warrior. Eight arrows damaged his internal organs, and he had several broken and fractured bones. The arrows were also poisoned...

You can examine his body and belongings. Maybe you will find some answers. He died without regaining consciousness, so I couldn't ask him anything.
Ask Ilya Molitvin about the dead orc and report to Ionas.

Since that Orc served the church, he must have resurrected, right? Oh, thank Creation... There is nothing worse for a healer than to lose a patient’s life. I still failed, but at least he's alive...

I heard that someone called Ilya Molitvin was the official Trinity Church representative in Polis. He must know who that orc is.

When you find that out, go back to Ionas. The dominae must know what is going on.
Did you get the answers to your questions?

The jigsaw is falling into place. At least now we know who attacked the Trinity Church representatives. And who helps Kyros in his dark deeds...

This is going nowhere good.
Teleport to the Spiral Ridge and start searching for Kyros.

Together with us, other sentient beings appeared on this allod... With their own customs and beliefs. Those arrows that you found and the horseshoe prints leave no doubt that centaurs are Kyros' allies.

Centaurs are a wild tribe that lives on the Spiral Ridge. No one but Kyros could ever find a common language with them. He challenged their chieftain and killed him, that's how he earned their respect and awe.

But this doesn't bring us any closer to solving the main mystery... Centaur magic is primitive. I don't believe any of them could open that portal.

However, this is where we should look for Kyros. Go there as fast as you can, Stormbringer.
Finally, someone's here! The centaurs have lost their marbles!
Go to Amos and tell him you are ready to participate in the Forum.

It is time for us to return to the tragedy you had to witness. Kyros has emerged from his grief... and now he's ready to face us. Some things you can't say telepathically. We need to hear about what happened from him too, not just from you.

I would like you to appear at the Forum like one of us. We may need your testimony.
Here you are. Now we can start the Forum.
Meet with Heracles near the Coliseum on the Dionic Archipelago.
Heracles invites you to join the Dionic Olympics and offers you to meet him. He will explain everything about the event and the rewards.

There you are, Stormbringer!

I had no doubts I’d see you soon. Have you heard of the Olympics? Think of the excitement, the rankings, and shiny victor’s laurels! Oh yes! I know that feeling!

So, Stormbringer. Are you ready to show the Domini and the whole Sarnaut what you’re made of? Ready to show who the real champion of the Dionic Games is?

Welcome to the Olympics!

Any questions? Ask away!
Dionic Olympics are where the true champions of Dionic Games meet!
During one day, win five gold medals in five trials of Dionic Games and bring them to Phoebus. If you exchange the medals for Dionic Emblems, you will not be able to turn them in to Phoebus!

I’m happy to see the sporting spirit of our guests!

Anyone can become a champion, but it’s not easy! In order to become a champion, you need to win a gold medal in every discipline... all in one day!

Do you think you’re worthy?
Five trials. Five gold medals. The rules are simple.

Excellent! I never doubted you, Stormbringer.

Go on and win enough Dionic Emblems to receive the title of Champion!
In 24 hours, participate in all five trails of Dionic Games and report to Phoebus.

So, the Games are on. Five trials open for everyone!

Amos is hosting the trial of speed - the chariot race. Dionysius is the patron of the dexterity trial - Pegasus flights! Kora’s trial is a test of your reaction and stamina - steeplechase. Ionas will challenge your stealth in the Underground Labyrinth. And mine is the trial of strength - Gladiator games in the Coliseum!

I invite you to participate in all of them. You will be greatly rewarded!
Five Trials. Each will reveal a new side to your talent. Don’t miss your chance!
Not bad! Maybe you want to become a champion? I think you could make it!
Complete 5 Challenges of Dionic Games and report to Aegala.
Are you ready for a special challenge of Dionic Games, Stormbringer? Complete every Dominus' challenge! Prove yourself worthy of the reward!
How are you progressing with the Challenges? Do not hurry, you have all the time in the world.

Amazing! You have surprised me, Stormbringer! It is an honor to announce you the worthiest!
Please, accept this whistle for the golden ghostly ball. When you have enough Dionic Emblems, you can have it right from my hands.
Meet Phoebus in Coliseum on Dionic Archipelago.

Greetings, Stormbringer!

The games organizers, the Dominus, and I prepared a special challenge for the participants of Dionic Games. Some might find it complicated... but it is not your case, isn't it?

I can't wait to see you in Coliseum.
Wonderful. I knew you'd be interested! Well, are you ready for the challenge?
Ask Gaal-Tohtar and Debacle Junior for help. Return to Amos.

Sometimes it seems to me that the title of Dominus of Fate is nothing but a mockery. Why else would my mind make me throw myself into mysteries that I cannot possibly unravel? I’m afraid I need your help, Stormbringer - otherwise the Aoidoi will be dishonored.

Ionas helped us build the road around the Archipelago. There was a clear purpose for that road - it was meant to serve as a track for the race trial. But you see, building a road is just half the work. Who was going to ride on it? So I decided to create chariots, powered by living force and magitechnology. But I know nothing either about taming wild beasts or mechanics... Luckily, some do. Maybe they can help me solve my problem?

I heard there was a great Priden tracker among our guests. I bet he could help me trap several bulls and tame them. I could also use help of a good mechanic... I know a goblin named Debacle Junior who is a master of his profession. Although some say he is a dangerous fellow...

Will you help me, Stormbringer?
Who doesn’t like speed? Nothing can be better than a break from the slowness of our everyday life.

Debacle’s creations are scary, but one shouldn’t doubt their effectiveness. I think the poor bulls are afraid of him. Thank you, my friend. I will not forget this.

Would you like to be the first to take the Road of the Winds?
Noose three wild bulls and bring them to Gaal-Tohtar.

Ay-hya, what am I even doing here? It’s the most boring place in the world! Nobody fights anyone. Nothing ever happens! Damn those peaceful Aoidoi.

What do you want, zoor? What? Trap some bulls? I used to do this when I was a kid, eysh! Do you call that entertainment? However... I have an idea. Why don’t YOU trap them? I will teach you. I bet it will be fun.

Here, kylys, take this noose. Throw it on a bull’s neck. Then it will run! If it runs towards you, be quick to dodge, and if it runs away, make sure to hold the rope tightly.

Now take this rope and go ahead!
Now take this rope and go ahead!

Haha, you’re a natural-born trapper, eysh! Just kidding. However, you trapped a couple of bulls with just bare rope. And not just somewhere but on Ammer, where they have so much life force! Be proud!

The job is done - the bulls are caught, your Amos is happy, and I had my fun. Now get lost, eysh!
Together with Debacle Junior, get to Eclipse and collect mana batteries from the watch keeper.

Hey there. What do you want?

What? You want to hire me as a mechanic? Ha! I’m making a reputation with Aoidoi! Well, nice to meet you. My name is Debacle Junior. What do you want me to do? Build a machine?

I could do that. I will just need a couple of mana batteries. A watch keeper at Eclipse promised to get me some! They may have been in use, but it doesn’t make them any worse.

Okay, so we need a boat to get to Eclipse. Let’s call it Operation Pi! That sounds mysterious enough.
That Amos must be a very wise guy.

Okay, now that’s what I call the assault of Eclipse! Not that little fight we had three years ago.

Your machine will be ready soon. A damn fine machine!

What do you mean a bull will pull it?!

Take part in Amos' Chariot race.

The race begins 5 times a day. You may find the schedule in the Calendar.

Dionic track is waiting for its riders! Feel the raging howl of the wind, hold your breath on every turn! Your only goal is to reach the finish line and be the first one to do so! Cut them off, use your chariot’s attacks - and victory will be yours!

Are you ready to ride your chariot in Dionic Race?
Are you ready to ride your chariot in Dionic Race?
That was a great race, Stormbringer! Here is your reward.
Complete Dionic Games: Chariot Race with extra objectives:

Well, if you're up for a real race... Accept my challenge!

You must finish first. Sounds easy, eh? No way. You have 4 minutes to do so. And you also have to collect all bonuses along the way. Every single one of them!

Let's see how you can make it, he-he.
Let's see how you can make it, he-he.
It cannot be! Is there anything at all that you can't complete?
Do a test drive on Amos’ chariot around the Archipelago.

Well, the chariots are ready, the roads are ready, the bulls are tamed... Time to start racing! You should be the first one to try out the great Dionic Track, Stormbringer!

Be careful though - Debacle mentioned some “explosive stuff” that he had installed on the chariots... I have no idea what that is!

This Debacle’s improvement looks... impressive. I like it.

I hope you’re satisfied, too, Stormbringer.
Accept Cosmos’ invitation and go to Cassandra’s house on the edge of Dionic Archipelago.

I can see you’ve done a lot for Dionic Games, Stormbringer. I thank you for that, but sadly another trouble has come our way. Something that can ruin the whole celebration... We need your talents.

Find Asclepia the healer near that house on the periphery. She will tell you what happened. Go!

Greetings, Stormbringer. The Dominae have approved of your assistance in dealing with our... problem.

I will try and keep it short.
Discover the nature of poison that Cassandra took.

One of the caldrons in the common canteen was poisoned. The food from that caldron was supposed to be served to dozens of people. Domina Cassandra took her host’s privilege and tried it first. In three heartbeats, she... fell asleep. Lost her consciousness, as they say on other allods.

I don’t even want to think of what would have happened if the food had been served to the guests! It would have killed them...

The Dominae think that you can help. Talk to Evrisius, the cook - no, he’s not guilty. And also Aera, the healer, who is trying to extract the poison from the caldron. We must find the evildoer! Or they can strike again.

If only I knew, Stormbringer. Of course I tried the food first, even before the Domina, but as you can see I’m perfectly fine. How could poison get into the caldron in those two minutes... I’m sure nobody approached it! I take my job very seriously.
h: How could poison get into the caldron?

t: A shame! Shame on my art!
Ask Froddy to give you the sprout of the Great Tree.

Don’t panic, of course we can beat that Nothing and banish it from our world. We need to call on the force of Creation itself. The Aoidos is still alive because she’s a descendant of Sarn and the Architect, and this means her body is filled with it. But she’s still mortal, so we need to make sure that Nothing never breaks out of her body. What? Do we need to keep her alive?

Oh, you’re asking for too much... Alright. I saw that gibberling guy strolling around, Froddy was his name, I believe. For some reason he had a sprout of the Great Tree hanging in a vial around his neck.

The tree is capable of resisting the Astral, and there’s a reason for that. It contains a great force - it can feed on anything and grow infinitely... Which makes it kind of similar to that poison. I bet that sprout can devour the darkness inside the Aoidos. You just need to persuade the gibberling to give up that sprout.

Hello. What a beautiful allod right? I hope I live to see our New Land flourish... What is it you want from me? Whaaat? The Great Tree? Are you out of your mind?

Tell me, why do you need it?

Oh, the Aoidos lady is in trouble... That's too bad. You see, our patron Nordrak is helping us restore the New Land. Once he used to be a Great Dragon! Now only his Spark is left of him, but it's still strong - the Great Tree keeps growing thanks to his power. It grows... out of him. Do you understand?

Nordrak will die soon, but his power and spirit will remain with us - in the shape of the Tree. It is one with the Dragon force, and we still need Dragons in our world... I was supposed to meet one here, actually. And I already have - I gave her the sprout, and now she takes care of it.

So now if anyone can help you, it’s Soliskar - that’s her name. She couldn’t have gone too far; in fact, I believe the Aoidoi invited her to stay.

I believe since the Dragons and the Tree have so much in common, she can help you cure Cassandra, right?

However grateful I am for what you did on that damned ship, I wouldn’t want to end up on the same allod as you.

You are called Stormbringer for a reason.
Together with Soliskar destroy the darkness in Cassandra’s body.

Hm! Humans’ impudence has always astounded me. I needed that sprout to restore my strength after what that demented sorceress had done to me. Nordrak knows that I have to... continue existing in this world.

Tell me, why do you think I would care about your miserable kind? Why would I help that woman?
Cassandra is getting worse. She’s dying...

I... can’t believe that! She’s breathing, her fever is fading, her skin turns normal again... Thanks Creation! Stormbringer, you work wonders!

Thanks to you and Soliskar and Klavdia and Froddy, Cassandra will live!
Cassandra lies still. You can see darkness sparkling under her eyelids.
Use the crystal to teleport to Cosmos’ residence and talk to him.

Thank you for everything, Stormbringer. Dominus Cosmos asked me to report on Cassandra’s disease, but I shouldn’t leave her alone. Could you tell him about everything that’s happened? He will be happy to hear the good news.

You can find him using this crystal.
Welcome, Stormbringer. Let me thank you again for helping Cassandra - each of us felt her pain, and your interference was a great relief for all of us...
Tell Phoebus the games have to be postponed.

By the way, we should postpone Phoebus’ Gladiator Games in our new timeline, otherwise it will cause a temporal conflict... I believe Phoebus wants you to participate in the first games, so I think you can convince him to put it off.

He knows nothing about the time shifts, and that’s how it should be.

Welcome, Stormbringer. Let me thank you again for helping Cassandra - each of us felt her pain, and your interference was a great relief for all of us...

What? You can’t take part in the games? What a shame. But it’s alright, I will wait.

I am glad to announce though that from now on all the trials are open for all visitors. And those who can win gold medals in several trials will be generously rewarded!
Participate in battle on Phoebus’ Gladiator Arena.

The Gladiator Arena welcomes the new warrior! All for bread and circuses! Remember that every victory is a great achievement, but a defeat is no disgrace as well.

When you are ready, I will tell you about the rules.
When you are ready, I will tell you about the rules.
That was a good fight, Stormbringer! Here is your reward.
Complete Dionic Games: Gladiator Battle with extra objectives.
Truly, Stormbringer, you are a great warrior!
Participate in the Gladiator combat held by Phoebus.

I am glad to announce that from now on the Gladiator Games are open for all visitors. And I would be honored if you could participate in the first battle held at the arena.

Everyone is equal there. All that matters is your dexterity and experience. If you can defeat opponents using the means that are available to you, you will be a champion. This is the Honor Combat.

Well, are you ready to try?

Here he is... And right on time, of course.

How are you feeling? The time has stopped for everyone on the Archipelago right now, except for us.
Encourage Aoidoi to participate in the games.

Excellent. I tried my best to make everyone see that participating is more important than winning... But their own vanity makes them feel intimidated. They’re afraid of losing, afraid of being disgraced.

Maybe you can influence them? See those young Aoidoi over there? You could talk to them and encourage them to participate in the games! That would be so great!
See those young Aoidoi over there? You could talk to them and encourage them to participate in the games! That would be so great!

Excellent, my friend. Victory is not the goal; the will for winning is. What’s the most valuable is the experience.

Aoidoi underestimate its importance. We, Aoidoi, have skipped our childhood, and that is our weakness.

I’m sorry, I don’t want to bore you with my reflections. Please enjoy the games!

Me? But... I’m a musician, not an athlete. What’s the point?

Alright, I will do as you suggest. Maybe I will find some inspiration in it... Or not. But still better than idling around.
h: Offer to participate in the games

t:
Oh, Stormbringer... Hello.

Not bad, right? The games, I mean. I wonder what it feels like to be an athlete.

Steeplechase is a simple discipline, but it does require some strength and dexterity.

Are you ready to try?
That was a good race, Stormbringer! Here is your reward.
Complete Dionic Games: Steeplechase with extra objectives:

If you find my trial to easy, try and complete is flawlessly! Not only you should collect bonuses along the way - you must not fall in water or return to checkpoints even once! Do you still think it's easy? Complete the trial during 160 seconds and collect at least 116 points!

Do you accept my challenge, Stormbringer?
Excellent! I never doubted you, Stormbringer.

My trial is ready, Stormbringer. Steeplechase is an ancient discipline, and I also find it quite symbolical.

All that matters is your speed, strength, and dexterity. And also your ability to make quick decisions. It’s just like life itself - you rush forward, you overcome the obstacles, and you draw your experience from it.

Do you want to know the rules?
The more obstacles we overcome, the more exciting it feels.

That was a nice race, Stormbringer. Not that we expected anything less from you.

Thank you for participating!
Ask Corci Gold-Tooth and Tur the Bull’s Roar for help.

Sorry, Stormbringer, I drifted away... My ambitions played a bad joke on me.

I intended to build something very special for the Dionic Games, but it took too much effort from me... But I’m not giving up! I will keep building until it’s finished!

No time for vanity, my friend. I have to ask you for help...

There are two peoples on Ammer whose assistance I need. Minotaurs are sturdy warriors and vigilant sentinels - I need them to guard the Labyrinth. And there are mountainfolk - nobody knows more about underground construction than they do. I can’t go on without their help and advise.

Could you speak with them, Stormbringer? I must admit I feel too intimidated to approach them myself.

I need coffee.

And I need it now!

The construction goes at full speed, thanks to you, Stormbringer! I don’t know how I can thank you.

Even Tur’s warriors expressed their willingness to assist the construction! Now it will be completed so much faster.
Go to the Spiral Ridge and obtain Tears of Gods, then bring them to Corci Gold-Tooth.

Who’s here? Let them come closer! What do they want? Can they speak?

Ah, you know how to please Corci, don’t you? Master Ionas sent you, right? He wants my people’s help?

Master Ionas deserves my respect. He’s a genius of his people. He can count on us!

But Mountainfolk don’t work for free. I need twelve measures of Tears of Gods which can be found only in these lands. Not less than that!

You go now and bring them!

You brought the Tears? Let me see.

Perfect stones! This is a decent payment. Tell Master Ionas we are ready to help.
Go to the Spiral Ridge and take away Centaurs’ weapons, then bring them to Tur on Dionic Archipelago.

You speak wisely! But we’re just mercenaries. We do what they pay us for.

What are you saying? Your stone master wants us to help? Why? Uh... Very interesting. So they want us to roam in the dark corridors and beat up anyone who comes in our way? That sounds entertaining!

But our weapons are designed to kill, and we’re not going to blunt them on purpose. We need something else! And I know where you can find it.

I know there are those Centaurs who keep bugging the locals. We can take their swords and maces, blunt them and use them! That will be completely safe. That’s a good idea, right?
Once we’re done, we’ll blunt their swords!

It hu-u-urts to look at these lame weapons. We don’t even need to blunt these, they aren’t sharp! Oh well, I’m just used to the good stuff... When I was you-u-ung, an ordinary club was enough!

Let’s roll! Tell your master he can count on us. His guys won't fail!
Complete Ionas’ trials in the Underground Labyrinth. Report on the results.
Good news, Stormbringer - we’re almost done. I think you should be the first one to try it out! And tell us what you think of our work.
I wonder what you think of our work!

Excellent! The Labyrinth works exactly how we intended it to. And the Minotaurs are doing a great job!

Thank you for your help. I’m not going to take any more of your time - somebody else might need you, too!
